spans.s:
छत्रः A mushroom.
--त्रं
1 A parasol,
an umbrella; अदेयमासीत्त्रयमेव भूपतेः
शशिप्रभं छत्रमुभे च चामरे

.
--2 Concealing the faults of
[]
one's teacher.
--Comp.
--धरः, --धारः
the bearer of an umbrella.
--धारण
{1} carrying or bearing an umbrella;

. {2} carrying an
umbrella as a type of royal authority.
--पतिः
{1} a king over whom an umbrella
is carried as a mark of dignity, a
sovereign, emperor. {2} N. of an
ancient king in जंबुद्वीप.
--भंगः {1}
‘destruction of the royal parasol’,
loss of dominion, deposition. {2}
dependence. {3} wilfulness. {4} a
forlorn condition, widowhood.

छात्रः [छत्रं गुरोर्वैगुण्यावरणं शीलमस्य
Sk.; छत्रा˚ ण] A pupil, disciple.
--त्रं A
kind of honey.
--Comp.
--गंडः an
indifferent poetical scholar,
knowing only the beginnings of stanzas.
--दर्शनं fresh butter prepared from
milk one day old.
--व्यंसकः a
roguish or dull-witted pupil.

1 A temple in honour of
Śiva.
--2 A bee-hive of a conical form.
--3 A king-fisher.
--त्रिका Mushroom.
--कं A mushroom.
छत्रिकः The bearer of an umbrella.

छत्रिन् a. (णी f.) Having or
bearing an umbrella. --m. A barber.

छात a.
1 Cut, divided.
--2
Feeble, thin, emaciated (p. p. of
छो q. v.).

छात्रकं Honey in the comb or
hive.
